annotations.title: Check whether a smaller box cuts shipping costs

description: Use this when a seller wants to cut shipping costs or asks whether their boxes are too big. Give each product's length, width, height and weight, and the inside size of the box it ships in now (up to 10 products). Compares the billable weight UPS/FedEx and USPS charge for the current box with the best-fitting in-stock Packrift box, leaving room for cushioning, and returns the billable pounds saved per shipment and per month, with product links. Billable weight is the larger of actual weight and dimensional weight (length x width x height / 139; USPS applies it above one cubic foot). Does not quote carrier rates or buy postage.

items.description: One row per product the seller ships, each in its own box.

current_box_height_in.description: Inside height of the box used now, in inches.

current_box_length_in.description: Inside length of the box used now, in inches.

current_box_width_in.description: Inside width of the box used now, in inches.

fragile.description: True for breakable items such as glass or ceramics; adds cushioning space.

monthly_shipments.description: Optional orders per month for this product, to total the monthly savings.

name.description: Short product name, e.g. "8 oz candle".
